newsitem.title: POLAND: Cussons Polish unit to invest $60 mln.
newsitem.headline: Cussons Polish unit to invest $60 mln.

text.p: The Polish unit of British-based soap maker Cussons International, a subsidiary of Paterson Zochonis Plc, plans to invest $60 million in the next two to three years, the deputy president of the Polish unit said.
"In the next two to three years we see investment of about $60 million, including at our plant in Warsaw, Pollena Uroda," John Farrell told a news conference on Friday.
He said Cussons had so far invested $20 million at its plant in the western town of Wroclaw, allowing it to become Poland's third largest detergent producer with a market share of 16.8 percent.
Cussons aquired the Warsaw Pollena Uroda plant in 1995, the Wroclaw plant in 1993.
